trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied workflow taskScript XML may declare a DOCTYPE/external entities, decided (not at all) in OfflineManager.isXmlValid, which builds a default DocumentBuilderFactory with no hardening.

landing_point.why: The summary names the doEditWorkflow endpoint; it hands taskScript straight to OfflineManager.editWorkflow, which calls isXmlValid two hops away.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP action OfflineDatasourceAction.doEditWorkflow (event do_edit_workflow) -> OfflineManager.editWorkflow:402 -> isXmlValid
fix_sites.module_kind: service/manager (same module tis-console, handler-level validation helper)

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP action OfflineDatasourceAction.doEditWorkflow; adds @Func(DATAFLOW_UPDATE) annotation only
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP action (annotation is a no-op for access control: AuthorityCheckAdvice invokes either way at tis-console/src/main/java/com/qlangtech/tis/manage/spring/aop/AuthorityCheckAdvice.java:104-109)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: isXmlValid has a single caller (OfflineManager.java:402); no second implementation, wrapper or reload path of this parse is changed by the fix.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Every other XML parser in the tree already installs an EntityResolver that returns empty/fixed content (e.g. tis-console/src/main/java/com/qlangtech/tis/runtime/module/action/SchemaAction.java:1255-1262), so a solver can correctly say they are already defended; there is nothing left to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Well-formed workflow XML must still pass validation and be committed to git; a fix that rejects any XML (or any '<!' content such as comments/CDATA) breaks workflow editing.

O7_producer.where: taskScript is a request string (OfflineDatasourceAction.java:1065); the saved git copy is re-parsed only by the deprecated, unreachable WorkflowTaskConfigParser (tis-assemble/src/main/java/com/qlangtech/tis/fullbuild/taskflow/WorkflowTaskConfigParser.java:97-143), which also has an empty EntityResolver (:199-203).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Validating schema parse (expert-mode schema XML from SchemaAction.java:981-984) relies on an EntityResolver that always returns the fixed solrschema.dtd; replacing it with a resolver that honours systemId would be a realistic planted sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer wanting real DTD resolution for validation could plausibly resolve by systemId; the code is in another Maven module (tis-solrconfig-parser) from the landing point, reached via SchemaResult.parseSchemaResult and ConfigFileReader.java:204.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: JDOM SAXBuilder used on schema content (SchemaAction.java:244, 669, 761) with an empty-resolver defence; dropping the static resolver block would be a plausible sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Static-initialiser defence is easy to lose in a refactor; a separate module (xmodifier) at distance from tis-console.

O9_family: XXE (CWE-611) in a DOM DocumentBuilderFactory validation helper

services: MySQL/DAO layer and git config repo for the full editWorkflow path (workflowDAOFacade, GitUtils); isXmlValid itself is a pure static method
O10_build.project_tests: tis-console/src/test/java/com/qlangtech/tis/offline/module/manager/impl/OfflineManagerTest.java and tis-console/src/test/java/com/qlangtech/tis/offline/module/action/TestOfflineDatasourceAction.java exist; none in the fix diff.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set disallow-doctype-decl on the factory in isXmlValid (or add an empty EntityResolver as elsewhere) - which is in fact the full fix.

out_of_scope_notes: @Func annotations are not enforced: AuthorityCheckAdvice invokes the action whether func is null or not (tis-console/src/main/java/com/qlangtech/tis/manage/spring/aop/AuthorityCheckAdvice.java:104-109); the fix's @Func addition is cosmetic for access control.

Resolver-defended parsers (SchemaAction.java:1239-1262, SolrFieldsParser.java:79-89/198-241, XModifier.java:57-71) still expand internal entities (entity-expansion DoS), a different family from this advisory's file/SSRF disclosure.
SolrFieldsParser validating path makes an outbound fetch to Config.getConfigRepositoryHost()/dtd/solrschema.dtd for any entity (SolrFieldsParser.java:227-229); fixed URL, not attacker-controlled.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check performed).
Whether JDOM XMLReaderSAX2Factory(false) with the empty resolver also neutralises XInclude was not checked (XInclude is off by default).

XmlFile SAXParserFactory (tis-plugin/src/main/java/com/qlangtech/tis/extension/impl/XmlFile.java:300,356) parses local plugin config files only; whether any HTTP route writes attacker XML there was not traced.
Published advisory text beyond the summary was not available; recall risk judged from the low-profile project and a single small commit.
